integrity: Mathematical proof and exact standalone finite-field checks supplied; independent validation not undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the diagonal integral Clebsch cubic over Z_5; general older modular treatments may give equivalent coverage. The finite-field program is supportive, not an infinite proof.
